text:
deploybot: auto-rollback queued for embeddings in eu-west-3 due to cost_ratio=2.6 for 5m. will revert to v2.8.0 in 10m unless acknowledged. :rotating_light:

jules: seeing the spike, only /v1/embeddings affected. no errors.

tariq: recent change enabled 'packed_attention' kernel on that route. suspect it.

ops-ivy: auto-rollback timer 7m. can we try a config toggle on canary first? less disruptive to customers.

sre-omar: agree. run canary toggle, watch embed_cost_per_1k and p95 latency for 3m. if improvement >50% propagate.

jules: holding auto-rollback for 12m to allow probe. deploybot: suppress auto-rollback.

deploybot: suppression applied by @jules for 12m. reason=canary_probe

(3m)

tariq: canary toggle applied: PACKED_ATTENTION=off. cost down ~72% on canary.

ops-ivy: propose progressive rollout 10% steps every 90s and a 12h pin to previous image to prevent flip-flop.

pm-sasha: PMs ok with pin + customer note if any tenants see billing impact.

sre-omar: added oncall rule: if embed_cost_p90 > 1.5x baseline for 10m and affected_tenants>3 -> escalate eng-releases with tag rollback_exec.

ops-ivy: executing rollout and pin now:
```bash
rdwctl rollout config eu-west-3 --set PACKED_ATTENTION=off --steps 10 --interval 90s
rdwctl pin set service:embeddings eu-west-3 --version 2.8.0 --duration 12h --reason "mitigate cost spike"
```

jules: thanks team. will update release notes: "temporary disable of packed_attention and 12h pin in eu-west-3 to address cost regression."

deploybot: suppression will expire after pin duration. auto-rollback re-enabled afterwards. thread closed unless new alerts.
